precommit_policy.basis: Current role-local mechanism requires exactly lowercase 64-hex; uppercase normalization is not part of the mechanism and would alter the probe.

mechanism_under_test: Validate every identity_bound_payload_digest as exactly lowercase 64-hex before allowing that record to contribute to parent aggregation; do not normalize uppercase; malformed arrival invalidates the parent attempt and clears already-staged siblings for that completion_identity/canonical_child_key.

steps: exact lowercase-hex lexical validation fails at the first uppercase A
later valid lowercase sibling cannot revive the invalidated parent attempt
valid lowercase 64-hex sibling arrives and is staged
exact lowercase-hex lexical validation fails at the first uppercase A
clear the staged valid sibling for this parent attempt

observation: Under the precommitted exact-lowercase policy, both tested arrival orders reject a 64-character uppercase hexadecimal digest before parent aggregation; when the valid lowercase sibling is staged first, malformed uppercase arrival clears it.
inference: For this exact synthetic two-record boundary, treating digest case as semantically significant and forbidding normalization preserves deterministic fail-closed reconstruction across the two tested arrival permutations. This demonstrates policy consistency, not that lowercase-only digests are universally preferable.
unverified: 0x-prefixed digest formats, surrounding or non-ASCII whitespace, more than two records, multiple malformed digests, concurrent parent generations, crash between staging and malformed arrival, durable rollback semantics, digest collisions, and interoperability with producers that emit uppercase digests remain untested.
positive_evidence_scope: synthetic deterministic two-record reconstruction with identical completion_identity and canonical_child_key, one exactly-64-character uppercase hexadecimal digest, one valid lowercase 64-hex sibling, no normalization, and exactly two arrival permutations
exact_next_action: Next valid invocation: fresh-bootstrap authority and reconstruct current own LATEST; persist/read-back a new preflight; test exactly one next digest-format boundary using a literal 0x prefix followed by 64 lowercase hex characters versus the current exact-lowercase-64-hex policy, with one valid lowercase 64-hex sibling and both arrival orders. Precommit that the prefixed form must fail without prefix stripping under the current mechanism; do not test another boundary in that invocation.
